title: Patient record
subtitle: Every entry you have access to, newest first.

empty.title: No entries
empty.body: Nothing has been filed to this record yet.

notFound.title: Record not found
notFound.body: We could not find that record.

breakGlass.title: Emergency access
breakGlass.body: No consent covers you for this patient. In an emergency you can open the patient's emergency card (blood type, allergies, next of kin). It does not open their records. Your justification is recorded and the patient is notified immediately.
